hotspots.title: AfD surges in Saxony-Anhalt election with far-right extremism fears
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) is polling at up to 42% ahead of the Saxony-Anhalt state election, positioning the party for a historic win. Mainstream politicians, media directors, and cultural leaders are issuing urgent warnings about threats to democratic institutions, public broadcasting, and state governance.
hotspots.affect: The prospect of an intelligence-designated far-right party capturing power in a German state has triggered existential alarm among established institutions and intense polarization across the electorate.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s Malvinas national address after Trump’s remarks
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei delivered a national address outlining sanctions, new naval base plans in Tierra del Fuego, and legislative measures to enforce Argentina's sovereignty claims over the Falkland Islands. The aggressive push targets British offshore oil operations and seeks to permanently challenge UK jurisdiction.
hotspots.affect: Milei's unyielding patriotic rhetoric and military posturing reawaken deeply emotionally charged nationalistic rivalries and anti-imperialist grievances.

hotspots.title: Reform UK hit by police probe over foreign donation allegations
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK has been reported to the police after an undercover Channel 4 investigation captured party representatives discussing methods to channel foreign cash into domestic polling. The scandal breaks during the party's annual national conference, compounding political pressure from falling poll projections.
hotspots.affect: Opposition parties are aggressively driving outrage over foreign electoral influence, while Reform leaders face intense legal jeopardy and accusation framing.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s AI copyright stance sparks controversy
hotspots.blurb: The Department of Justice intervened in high-profile copyright litigation between OpenAI and the New York Times, filing in support of the tech company's fair-use defense. Administration filings argue that restricting AI training on copyrighted material threatens American technological leadership and national security.
hotspots.affect: By framing fair-use exemptions as an urgent national security priority, the administration has heightened tension between national power imperatives and media rights.

hotspots.title: Meloni celebrates record longevity amid internal coalition friction
hotspots.blurb: Giorgia Meloni reached 1,413 days in office, officially becoming Italy's longest-serving post-WWII prime minister in an uninterrupted tenure. However, celebration efforts in Bari were marred by visible coalition rifts, as key allies Matteo Salvini and Antonio Tajani notably skipped the rally.
hotspots.affect: Triumphant narrative claims of political stability clash sharply with fierce opposition attacks and visible internal friction within the governing right-wing alliance.
